SP001.name: Execute
SP001.description: Deals true damage to finish low-HP targets, ignoring shields; refunds 40% cooldown on a kill.

SP002.name: Retribution
SP002.description: Deals true damage to creeps/objectives and upgrades with jungle blessings.

SP003.name: Inspire
SP003.description: Boosts attack speed and enhances basic attacks with defense shred/sustain.

SP004.name: Sprint
SP004.description: Grants a speed burst and slow immunity for chasing, escaping, or rotating.

SP005.name: Revitalize
SP005.description: Drops an area healing spring that restores HP and boosts healing/shield effects.

SP006.name: Aegis
SP006.description: Grants a protective shield to you and a nearby low-HP ally.

SP007.name: Petrify
SP007.description: Deals magic damage and briefly stuns/slows nearby enemies.

SP008.name: Purify
SP008.description: Cleanses crowd control/debuffs and grants temporary control immunity and movement speed.

SP009.name: Flameshot
SP009.description: Fires a long-range magic projectile for poking/finishing and can knock back close enemies.

SP010.name: Flicker
SP010.description: Blinks a short distance and grants brief defense bonuses.

SP011.name: Arrival
SP011.description: Teleports to an allied turret or minion after channeling, with a speed/attack follow-up.

SP012.name: Vengeance
SP012.description: Reduces incoming damage and reflects damage back to attackers.
